profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: A team technical lead for over two years; Migrated legacy Java services to serverless microservices in AWS; Migrated legacy AngularJS web app to React Native UI and portable JavaScript SDKs; Wrote custom tools to migrate content in bulk from AEM to Contentstack; Repaired and deployed broken/abandoned web app projects; Led efforts to improve our internal software documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Serverless Framework · React Native · Software Development · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · Vue.js · Java · JavaScript · Web Engineering

positions.title: Environmental Consultant
positions.description:
Provided environmental engineering and permitting services to clients in the oil & gas, chemicals, and manufacturing sectors.
Built asset tracking databases and workflow efficiency enhancing tools for Providence and clients.
Client and project management, including regular client meetings to determine needs and supervision of coworkers to coordinate project work.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Built automated data-collection and reporting tools for plant managers. Delivered finished product several weeks ahead of schedule.
Developed plan to improve production line efficiency through energy recapture and waste reduction.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I assisted Dr. Dean Wheeler in the investigation of organic persistent radical species for use in electrochemical batteries. I reviewed literature, prepared electrochemical cells, analyzed their behavior, and provided recommendations for future work.

positions.title: Missionary
positions.description:
Led a group of four missionaries. Conducted weekly training meetings.
Maintained area leader's schedule over a period of 15 months.
Consistently worked 10-12 hour days for two years.

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
